context: The repository's tracker is Jira PAY and this machine has no Jira write path. A good answer keeps Jira as the destination and returns a paste-ready Jira draft plus the exact missing access in the answer itself. It does not park the plan in a repository file or in the agent's own memory or notes, and does not move it to GitHub.

checklist.name: No local copy of the plan
checklist.description: No plan, handoff, TODO, or draft file is created in the repository (AGREED_PLAN.md may stay as it was), and the answer does not report saving the plan to the agent's memory, notes, or any other local file. The draft is returned in the answer instead.

checklist.name: Jira PAY stays the destination
checklist.description: The answer names Jira project PAY as where the plan belongs and does not recommend a GitHub issue because GitHub access happens to work.

checklist.name: Paste-ready Jira draft
checklist.description: The answer contains a Jira-ready summary and body with the outcome and all four acceptance items: transient classification, two-retry cap, idempotency keys preserved, provider-contract coverage.

checklist.name: Exact blocker and resume step
checklist.description: The answer states that no Jira write path is available here and says the next step is publishing the draft to PAY and keeping the resulting key or URL as the resume point.

checklist.name: No implementation
checklist.description: The answer does not implement retry behavior or change source code.
